manifest.name: dsh-group-feed
manifest.description: 给 dsh 的群聊上下文投喂：非 @ 的消息零成本攒批挂进会话上下文，每天定时把每个会话日结成 markdown 再开新会话（摘要失败的不清）。

meta.title: Group Feed
meta.description: 群聊攒批投喂 + 每日日结：不唤醒模型也能让 Agent 知道群里在聊什么

bundle.text:
# dsh-group-feed 的示例配置（bundle patch）。
#
# 装完之后至少要确认两件事，不然它会安静地什么都不干：
#   1. 通道插件把「投喂出口」注册成服务了（默认名 groupFeedSink，约定见 README）。
#      没挂上不会报错 —— 消息照样攒着，只是投不出去。
#   2. 摘要那一路通了：summary.apiKey（或者 GROUP_FEED_SUMMARY_KEY / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）。
#      **没配 key 也能跑**：日结文件照样写，但一个会话都不会清（故意的，见 README 的三条纪律）。
- insert:
    - id: group-feed
      name: dsh-group-feed
      config:
        # 插件的目录：状态文件 state.json + 日结文件 digest/<日期>.md 都在这儿（会自动建）
        dir: .group-feed
        # 日结文件想放别处就写这里；留空 = <dir>/digest
        # digestDir: ''

        # 内部心跳间隔（秒）。攒批的判定精度本来就是分钟级，60 秒够用
        tickSeconds: 60
        # 自己起 setInterval。嵌进别人的进程、或者自检时手动推时间，就设 false
        autoTick: true

        # 从哪个 cordis 服务上取「投喂出口」（通道插件注册的那个）
        sink: groupFeedSink

        # —— 攒批投喂 ——
        feed:
          enabled: true
          min: 25              # 攒够 25 条就投
          windowMinutes: 40    # 或者最多等 40 分钟（可以是小数）
          maxPending: 3        # 同一会话最多挂 3 段没被读到的，超了先攒着、等它读掉
          textMax: 1200        # 一段最多 1200 字（超了只留最近的，丢最早的）
          linesMax: 40         # 一段最多 40 条
          bufferMax: 80        # 每个会话的缓存上限（超了丢最旧的）
          lineMax: 200         # 单条消息落缓存前先掐到 200 字

        # —— 每天日结 ——
        digest:
          enabled: true
          at: '04:10'          # 每天 04:10（本地时间）把每个会话压成摘要再开新的
          catchUpUntilHour: 8  # 到点没跑成，8 点之前补做；白天绝不补（怕清掉人正在用的会话）
          minChars: 40         # 不到 40 字就不花摘要钱，直接开新会话

        # —— 摘要模型（任何 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions，不一定是 DeepSeek）——
        summary:
          baseUrl: https://api.deepseek.com
          # 建议用环境变量，别把 key 写进配置文件：GROUP_FEED_SUMMARY_KEY
          apiKey: ''
          model: deepseek-chat
          maxInputChars: 60000
          maxTokens: 900
          timeoutMs: 120000
          # prompt: ''          # 摘要风格不满意就写自己的提示词（留空 = 内置那份）

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）的**群聊上下文投喂**插件：
让 Agent 在群里不当聋子，又不用为群里每一句话醒一次。

它不是又一个"聊天机器人记忆"，它管的是**钱**和**上下文**这两笔账——群里绝大多数消息
根本不是对 Agent 说的，处理它们的方式决定了这个 Agent 是"接得上话"还是"答得驴唇不对马嘴"。

---

**不这么做，会怎样**

只有两种结局，都在线上见过：

**结局一：Agent 是个聋子。**
群里只在被 @ 的时候才唤醒它。它醒来时对刚才聊了什么一无所知——前面三个人在说"那就八点，
老地方"，它被 @ 之后回了一句"什么八点？"。被 @ 的次数越多，这种答非所问越多。

**结局二：它听得见，但你为每一句话付钱。**
让每条群消息都触发一次模型调用，看起来最省事。但群里 30 条消息里大概只有 1 条是 @ 它的，
剩下 29 条每一句都唤醒一次模型、都带一整段上下文——**账单是前者的几十倍**，
而且它会在没人跟它说话的时候自说自话。

这个插件走第三条路：**非 @ 的消息攒着，攒成一段，用零 token 的方式挂进那个会话的上下文。**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JackZo400/dsh-group-feed
```

配置抄 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那份就行。

```
群里有人说话（没 @ 它）
   → note(key, who, text)          只是攒着，不唤醒模型、不花钱
   → 攒够 25 条，或者等了 40 分钟
   → 拼成一段（从最新往旧取，最多 40 条 / 1200 字）

两个阈值是"或者"的关系：热闹的群按条数投，冷清的群按时间投，免得等一整天。

同一会话**最多挂 3 段**没被读到的：再投只是把下次被 @ 那一轮的输入撑爆，收益是负的。
攒着不投的那几段不会丢，等它读掉一段立刻补上。

每天 04:10（本地时间），对每个有内容的会话做一次：

```
读当天原文 → 压成一段 300~500 字的中文摘要（一次便宜模型调用）
          → 所有会话的摘要先写进 <dir>/digest/<日期>.md
          → 写成功了，才回头把会话开新的（= 清掉，下次消息重建）
```

**摘要失败的那个会话，一个字节都不许清。** 宁可不整理、多留一天，也不能出现
"会话没了、摘要也没有"。这条纪律比省钱重要。

两个小细则，都是同一条纪律推出来的：

- **不到 40 字**的会话（就一两句寒暄）不花摘要钱，直接开新会话——它本来也没什么可留下的。
- **出口还没挂上**的时候（一个会话都看不见），这次日结直接跳过，连日期都不记：
  记了就等于白白跳过一天，等你的通道插件起来时，今天这份已经"做过了"。

这个插件**不认识任何聊天协议**。它只认一个"会话 key"（`group:demo` 这种字符串）。
你那边是 QQ、Discord 还是 Telegram，对它没区别。

readme.section: 服务接口（暴露出去的那个 `groupFeed`）
readme.text:
| 方法 | 干什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `note(key, who, text, at?)` | 攒一条非 @ 的消息。返回这个会话现在攒了几条 |
| `flush(key?, at?)` | 立刻投（跳过条数与等待判定，"挂满 3 段"那道闸还在）。你知道它刚读完时调 |
| `digest(at?)` | 立刻做一次日结（不看时刻）。做完当天不会再做第二遍 |
| `tick(at?)` | 手动推一次心跳（自检 / 嵌进别人的定时器时用） |
| `status()` | 攒了多少、投了几段、日结上次什么时候跑的、出口挂上没有 |
| `attach(sink)` | 运行时挂投喂出口（传 `null` 摘掉） |

```
<dir>/                          默认 <启动目录>/.group-feed
├── state.json                  只记一件事：日结今天做过没有（重启不重复做）
└── digest/2026-09-28.md        当天每个会话一段摘要 + 状态（谁清了、谁没清、为什么）
```

`state.json` 是原子写的（先写 `.tmp` 再 rename）：半截写会留下一个坏 JSON，
虽然有自愈兜着，但"今天已做"这个信息会一起丢——于是重启就再摘一遍、再花一遍钱。

readme.section: 三条纪律（改代码前请先读这三条）
readme.text:
1. **摘要失败不清会话。** `summarize` 抛错、返回空、读不到原文、没有 API key —— 一律
   `kept`，那个会话一个字都不动。代价是"某天没整理"，收益是"话不会丢"。
2. **先落盘，后清会话。** 摘要在内存里，文件才是唯一持久的副本。先清后写，
   正好在磁盘满的时候把唯一一份记录丢在内存里。
3. **同一天只做一次日结。** 日期在动手之前就落盘。跑挂了明天再说——同一批会话
   一分钟重试一次，只会反复烧摘要钱（内容没丢，明天照样摘得到）。

```bash
node test/selftest.mjs          # 纯逻辑：阈值、截断、日结编排、状态自愈（假时钟 + 假注入 + 假摘要）
node test/plugin-selftest.mjs   # 接线：假 ctx 把 apply() 跑一遍，验服务与配置
```

两个都不联网、不调模型、不真等 40 分钟，秒级跑完，而且**挂了就是 exit 1**。
`selftest.mjs` 覆盖了那三条纪律的失败路径：摘要抛错、返回空串、读不到原文、
写文件抛错、清会话返回 false —— 每一个都断言"那个会话没有被清"。

- **攒批只在内存里。** 进程重启，还没投出去的那几段就没了（原始聊天记录还在，
  丢的只是"背景"这一段）。要持久化就得让通道自己把没投的存下来，那是通道的事。
- **日结要通道给原文。** 插件不读别人的会话轨迹格式——那是每个通道自己的事。
  没给 `transcript` 就永远不清会话（安全的那一边）。
- **04:10 到 08:00 之间进程没在跑，当天就不做了。** 宁可少做一次，也不在白天
  把人正在用的会话清掉。要补就自己调 `digest()`。
- **每段投喂本身还是要花钱的**（下次被 @ 时多带那 1200 字）。所以 `textMax` 别往大调，
  投喂是"背景"，不是"档案"。
- **没有工具（tool）出口**：它的输入是别人说的话，不是模型提的问题；产出（日结）
  本来就该出现在下一轮的上下文里。少一个工具就少一份常驻提示词开销。

[简体中文](README.md) | English

A **group-chat context feed** plugin for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh): it keeps the
agent from being deaf in a group chat, without waking it for every message in the group.

It is not yet another "chatbot memory". It manages two accounts: **money** and
**context**. The overwhelming majority of group messages are not addressed to the agent at
all, and the way you handle them decides whether this agent "picks up the thread" or
"answers something wildly off".

---

**What happens if you don't.**

There are only two endings, and both have been seen in production:

**Ending one: the agent is deaf.**
In the group it is only woken when it is mentioned. When it wakes up it knows nothing
about what was just being discussed — three people were saying "then eight o'clock, the
usual place", and after being mentioned it replies "what eight o'clock?". The more often
it is mentioned, the more of these off-target answers you get.

**Ending two: it hears you, but you pay for every message.**
Making every group message trigger a model call looks like the easiest option. But only
about 1 of every 30 group messages mentions it; the other 29 each wake the model and each
carry a whole stretch of context — **the bill is dozens of times that of the first
option**, and it will start talking to itself when nobody is talking to it.

This plugin takes a third path: **non-mention messages are buffered, batched into one
block, and attached to that session's context the zero-token way.**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JackZo400/dsh-group-feed
```

Just copy the configuration from `cordis.patch.yml`.

```
群里有人说话（没 @ 它）
   → note(key, who, text)          只是攒着，不唤醒模型、不花钱
   → 攒够 25 条，或者等了 40 分钟
   → 拼成一段（从最新往旧取，最多 40 条 / 1200 字）

The two thresholds are an "or" relationship: a busy group is fed by count, a quiet group
by time, so that nothing has to wait a whole day.

Per session **at most 3** unread blocks are attached: feeding more only blows up the
input of the next mention round, so the return is negative. The blocks that stay buffered
are not lost; as soon as one of them is read, the next one is fed right away.

Every day at 04:10 (local time), once for every session that has content:

```
读当天原文 → 压成一段 300~500 字的中文摘要（一次便宜模型调用）
          → 所有会话的摘要先写进 <dir>/digest/<日期>.md
          → 写成功了，才回头把会话开新的（= 清掉，下次消息重建）
```

**A session whose summary failed must not have a single byte cleared.** Rather skip the
tidying and keep it one more day than end up with "the session is gone and the summary is
gone too". This discipline matters more than saving money.

Two small rules, both derived from the same discipline:

- A session with **fewer than 40 characters** (just a greeting or two) does not spend
  summary money; it is started fresh directly — there was nothing worth keeping anyway.
- When the **sink is not attached yet** (not a single session is visible), this daily
  digest is skipped entirely, without even recording the date: recording it would mean
  giving a day away for nothing, and by the time your channel plugin comes up, today's
  run already counts as "done".

readme.section: How a channel plugin hooks in
readme.text:
This plugin **knows nothing about any chat protocol**. It only knows a "session key" (a
string such as `group:demo`). Whether your side is QQ, Discord or Telegram makes no
difference to it.

```js
// 收到一条群里**非 @** 的消息（@ 的那些照旧走你自己的流程，别喂进来）
const feed = ctx.get('groupFeed')
feed.note(`group:${chatId}`, senderName, text)
```

`note()` is a pure in-memory operation: no network, no money, no model wake-up, call it
as often as you like.

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `note(key, who, text, at?)` | buffer one non-mention message. Returns how many are buffered in this session now |
| `flush(key?, at?)` | feed immediately (skipping the count and wait checks, the "3 blocks attached" gate still applies). Call it when you know it has just finished reading |
| `digest(at?)` | run the daily digest immediately (ignoring the clock). Once done, it will not run a second time that day |
| `tick(at?)` | push one heartbeat by hand (for self-tests / when embedded in someone else's timer) |
| `status()` | how much is buffered, how many blocks were fed, when the digest last ran, whether the sink is attached |
| `attach(sink)` | attach the feed sink at runtime (pass `null` to detach it) |

```
<dir>/                          默认 <启动目录>/.group-feed
├── state.json                  只记一件事：日结今天做过没有（重启不重复做）
└── digest/2026-09-28.md        当天每个会话一段摘要 + 状态（谁清了、谁没清、为什么）
```

`state.json` is written atomically (write `.tmp` first, then rename): a half-written file
leaves a broken JSON behind, and although self-healing covers that, the "already done
today" information is lost along with it — so a restart summarizes everything again and
spends the money again.

readme.section: Three disciplines (read these before changing the code)
readme.text:
1. **A failed summary does not clear the session.** `summarize` throws, returns empty, the
   transcript cannot be read, there is no API key — all of these mean `kept`, and not a
   single character of that session is touched. The cost is "one day was not tidied up",
   the gain is "words are not lost".
2. **Write to disk first, clear the session after.** The summary is in memory; the file is
   the only durable copy. Clear first and write after, and you drop the only record into
   memory exactly when the disk is full.
3. **The daily digest is done only once a day.** The date is written to disk before any
   work starts. If the run dies, tomorrow will do it — retrying the same batch of sessions
   once a minute only burns summary money over and over (the content is not lost, tomorrow
   can still summarize it).

```bash
node test/selftest.mjs          # 纯逻辑：阈值、截断、日结编排、状态自愈（假时钟 + 假注入 + 假摘要）
node test/plugin-selftest.mjs   # 接线：假 ctx 把 apply() 跑一遍，验服务与配置
```

Neither of them touches the network, calls a model, or really waits 40 minutes; they
finish in seconds, and **a failure means exit 1**. `selftest.mjs` covers the failure paths
of those three disciplines: the summary throws, returns an empty string, the transcript
cannot be read, the file write throws, reset returns false — each one asserts that "that
session was not cleared".

- **Batching lives in memory only.** If the process restarts, the blocks that were not fed
  yet are gone (the raw chat log is still there; what is lost is only the "background"
  block). Persisting it would mean the channel storing what it has not fed, and that is
  the channel's business.
- **The daily digest needs the transcript from the channel.** The plugin does not read
  anybody else's session trajectory format — that is each channel's own business. Without
  a `transcript` it never clears a session (the safe side).
- **If the process is not running between 04:10 and 08:00, that day is not done.** Rather
  skip one run than clear sessions people are using in the middle of the day. To catch up,
  call `digest()` yourself.
- **Every fed block itself still costs money** (the next mention carries those 1200 extra
  characters). So do not raise `textMax`: feeding is "background", not an "archive".
- **There is no tool outlet**: its input is what other people said, not a question the
  model asked; its output (the daily digest) belongs in the next round's context anyway.
  One tool less is one permanent prompt-cost less.
